title: Zesty Smoky Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dish featuring smoky paprika and lamb, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This keto-friendly recipe is easy to make and packed with flavor.
instructions: Preheat the grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together smoky paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the grill with olive oil to prevent sticking.
Grill the kebabs for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until the lamb is cooked to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Brush the kebabs with lemon juice during the last minute of cooking.
Remove the kebabs from the grill and garnish with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, with your choice of sides.
